scope: Independent read-only semantic audit of the frozen onpolicy teacher calibration; one JSON output, no source edits or cluster mutations.

conclusion.verdict: Actual semantic failure in this frozen prompt/format; no oracle, left-to-right prompt, demonstration, EOS normalization, executable-score, or split-overlap bug found.
conclusion.bounded_to: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B revision 851bf6e806efd8d0a36b00ddf55e13ccb7b8cd0a, seed 37, 16 shared dev inputs across 5 suites, 2 paired instruction variants, greedy non-thinking decoding, max_new_tokens 32.

provenance.source_hash_note: The runtime hashes five ordered source filenames plus bytes (run.py:73-78), a different digest construction from the bundle identifier. Runtime digest was independently reproduced.
provenance.local_evidence_note: Read actual remote source/run first; independently analyzed author-collected raw receipts and metadata after their SHA-256 matched the remote originals. Did not read author analysis conclusions or duplicate artifacts.

independent_checks.oracle_method: Independent sequential state transform: dax uses explicit descending index enumeration; wug uses index (i+1) modulo list length; fep uses lookup {0:1,1:2,2:3,3:0}; kiv uses lookup {0:1,1:0,2:3,3:2}. Each step consumes the preceding result. Gold was computed before comparison to production execute.
independent_checks.gold_digest_encoding: SHA-256 of JSON mapping example_id to independently computed integer list, keys sorted, separators comma and colon without spaces.
independent_checks.exhaustive_oracle_domain: All 256 four-item lists over 0..3, including constant lists, across all 11 distinct manifest programs.
independent_checks.prompt_reconstruction: Independently reconstructed both formats from their literal instructions, eight primitive demonstrations with independently computed answers, task-specific authoritative rules, and unanswered final query; all 160 SHA-256 values matched records.
independent_checks.prompt_order: Current explicitly says given order; numbered gives step 1 then step 2 and requires the preceding result. Definition and demo semantics agree.
independent_checks.model_chat_template: Cached Qwen3.5 template preserves the user content and appends assistant with empty think block when enable_thinking=False, consistent with model.py:165-178; no conflicting instruction detected.

split_check.interpretation: Same 16 dev inputs are intentionally reused across five suites; current/numbered are paired. The 160 outputs are not 160 independent input samples. Primary heldout boundaries were recomputed from all four frozen preflight/pilot configs, without scoring heldout cases.

normalization_and_score.replay_method: Native tokenizer vocabulary spells every body token as one of [, ], comma, digits 0..3, or ByteLevel space. Concatenation plus terminal EOS removal exactly reproduces every recorded output.
normalization_and_score.grading: Parse the entire stripped output as JSON, require four true integers in 0..3, compare the ordered list with independent gold. Whitespace does not affect correctness; no substring extraction or removal of internal special tokens.
normalization_and_score.logprob_limit: Gold log probability scores one compact JSON serialization and includes EOS only in gold_complete_logprob. It is format-sensitive; it is not used to decide executable correctness.

failure_categories.method: Exclusive classification of composition outputs: correct full program, exact output of a nonempty proper subsequence of the requested steps, reversed full program, unchanged input, other. Matches are output equivalences, not evidence of the model's hidden reasoning.
failure_categories.notes: Current wug-dax example matches dax alone. Numbered fep-kiv example matches fep alone. Current dax-fep example matches kiv on the original input, an operation absent from that query. A global order reversal cannot explain the observed errors.

frozen_qwen3_control.interpretation: Meaningful diagnostic model-family/runtime control under an already frozen task protocol. It cannot isolate architecture causally because checkpoint weights, model training, tokenizer, native chat template, and model implementation differ.
frozen_qwen3_control.template_difference: Qwen3.5 enable_thinking=False appends an empty think block; cached Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 template appends only the assistant header.
frozen_qwen3_control.pass_interpretation: A passing control would qualify that checkpoint on this frozen dev protocol and narrow the present failure to the tested Qwen3.5 setup.
frozen_qwen3_control.fail_interpretation: A failing control would leave qualification unresolved for these prompts; it would not establish a universal limit on teacher composition.

limitations: No new model generation or forward pass; this is an independent semantic and source audit of persisted outputs.
Zero updates are supported by source guards, event log, empty schedules and run receipts; model weight shards were not rehashed.
Full serialized chat token prefixes are not saved in records; plaintext prompt hashes and native template source were verified.
No conclusions about general teacher capability, continual learning, or a causal architectural mechanism follow from this calibration.
